name: Oribe Ibuki
source:
"I love you so much, Alice. So that means it's perfectly legal to squeeze and kiss you all over, huh!"

Height: Tall
Figure: Plump
Appearance: Fluffy Onee-san
Hobbies: Messing with Alice, being messed with by Alice, collecting cute things

[url=https://vndb.org/c39144]Alice[/url]'s childhood friend who lives and works as a maid in the Kugayama household.  Alice always finds her annoying, but Ibuki sees that as her way of showing love.

Everyone knows she's quite polished in the art of perversion, although she doesn't consider it like that.  She likes Alice so much that Ibuki's every move is centered around her.

She's always smiling, able to complete anything at will but can't handle scary things in general, like ghost stories, rollercoasters, and thunder.  Another nickname she calls Alice by besides Milady is "Awe-chan," which she came up with when they were young.  Alice would shy away upon hearing that name.

Featured in Drama CD Vol. 3 "Motto, Zutto, Gyutto" (lit. Hug me, longer, forever)

[Translated from [url=http://www.particle.jp.net/lilycle_rs/chara03.html]Official Site[/url]]
